title: Prenuvo footer
description: A night footer with an arced top, fading from black to deep teal. The thin wordmark, four link columns under small muted uppercase labels (the last with phone and email lines and a row of social icons), and an ocean-teal newsletter card on the right with light fields over a photo slot. A quiet legal row closes it. Links dim on hover.
notes: the newsletter photo slot fills the card's lower half (cover); empty shows a placeholder
the form only posts to newsletter.action; there is no script
name: prenuvo-footer
